reviews.text: Dr. Ravi is the best! I have an 8yr old bunny Sid. He wasn't eating or drinking. He was really sick.I thought I was going to lose him. Dr. Ravi was so gentle n sweet with him. He did everything possible n Sid is fully recovered. Every time I've scheduled an appointment they've taken him either that same day or the next. Dr. Ravi calls to check up on your pet. His staff are kind. Imo he's the best vet around. Thank you Dr. Ravi!
Gave us an appointment to get my cat's rabies vaccine right away, took us in an hour early for the appointment, it was super quick, super friendly, and well kept. Would definitely recommend!
Sam is so compassionate and helpful!

This Vet is a top- notch expert in his field.  When we lived by them we had a female cat who was fixed twice by another local vet and was she was still going into heat.  In desperation, we took her to Compassionate Vet.  After 3 hours of looking inside her, he finally found a very small piece of her ovaries maybe the size of a ditalini macaroni.  We were overjoyed and extremely grateful.  He is a very caring brilliant Vet.
first time visit Doctor very accommodating Allergy shot administered without delay

Been with the Doc for about 10 years now tonight I went in and had the most amazing experience with his technician,  Sam. She cared for my baby like he was her own. My cat Ziggy is a little skittish when it comes to leaving the house. Doc prescribed him some meds and I was able to get him over with no problem always a pleasure doing business with Compassionate care Vet!!
Evening hours are so convenient and staff are amazing! They are also super easy to reach via phone especially when in a hurry to talk to someone. I feel comfortable trusting my pets care with them.

Google says they open at 5:30 AM so I went over there and no one in sight. I didn't have time to wait since my dog had a medical emergency. I am very disappointed that the closest place that was opened doesn't have the correct hours making me drive out of the way just to be let down.
Very caring and gentle with my elderly Yorkie. Would highly recommend for your fur baby needs.
